violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk
violation_type.typical_finding: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver gave a toddler Mike and Ike candy which can be a choking hazard for that age group. The caregiver no longer works at the operation.

finding_variants.text: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver gave a toddler Mike and Ike candy which can be a choking hazard for that age group. The caregiver no longer works at the operation.
Infants aged 10 to 16 months old were observed to be eating pretzels for snack. These were removed at inspection.
During inspection, whole grapes were served for infants and toddlers that presents a choking hazard for young children.

During lunch I observed the operation serving hotdogs that were not cut into smaller pieces and presented a choking hazard.     This was corrected when the caregivers cut the hotdogs into smaller pieces.
Whole wieners were served to children under the age of 4. Serving children whole wieners is a choking hazard. This was corrected at inspection.
Two and three year old children were served whole wieners. This is a choking gazard for chidlren under the age of 4.
